What's free

Concrete tools, zero paywall

ClaudeNovo lists every capability as free by default. Open the editor and use them without upgrades or credit packs.

  1. 01

    AI background removal — free

    Remove image backgrounds in the browser. Included in the editor at no cost, running on your device.

  2. 02

    Expand, upscale & vectorize — free

    Extend images, boost resolution, and convert rasters to vectors. These AI image tools are free and stay local.

  3. 03

    Frames, shapes & text on path — free

    Rectangles, ellipses, polygons, stars, pen paths, and text-on-path for logos and labels, with opacity and layout controls.

  4. 04

    Layers & local projects — free

    Rename, lock, hide, and reorder layers. Projects save in your browser storage so work stays on your device.

  5. 05

    PNG & JSON export — free

    Export PNG to share, or JSON to reopen later in ClaudeNovo — no export quota.

FAQ

Questions, answered

What is free, what the tools do, and where your files live.

Is everything in ClaudeNovo free?

Yes. The editor and its tools are free to use in your browser, including AI background removal, expand, upscale, vectorize, vector drawing, text on path, layers, and export. No account is required.

Which free features are included?

Free features include: AI background removal, image expand, resolution boost, vectorize, frames and shapes, pen paths, text and text on path, layer management, and PNG/JSON export.

Do my designs leave my computer?

Design projects are stored locally in your browser. Editing features such as background removal run on your device. We do not upload your design files to ClaudeNovo servers for editing.

Do I need to sign up?

No. Open the editor and start designing. There is no account wall for core editing or the free AI image tools.
